model.name: test:R31.2 cookie-only — ?token= URL grants NO auth (ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner)
model.description: Bridged to test/visual/r312-owner-gate-security.mjs (line 120, DET-3x GREEN, served==HEAD==v0.7.101). Verifies R31.2 AC-cookie-only: GET /server-manager?token=<OWNER literal> with NO sm_session cookie and NO x-player-token header -> 403 AND the body does NOT leak the page shell. RED baseline proven non-vacuously at SOURCE: pre-fix ServerManagerGuard.playerTokenFrom (730b57e2f^) had q.get(token)||q.get(playerToken) query fallback = the leak; post-fix (730b57e2f) header-only. Marker b0ee7dc6 STAGED by req (PO-directed) + written+run by tester -> now minted. Proves the URL ?token= query-auth path grants no access = cookie-only enforced; guards a future ?token= regression. Chain: R31.2 req 5bc9683e -> UC 40802701 -> ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner -> Impl 335dbf3d -> this Test (alongside owner-gate Test 87b040ee).
